RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel often reflects executive demographics rather than intentional discrimination, though affinity bias remains a documented risk. Furthermore, for a "head of" role, broad regulatory affairs experience is a legitimate, critical leadership qualification that could distinguish the successful candidate despite your stronger technical credentials. 

Before raising gender bias, politely follow up on your written feedback request. Raising the panel's composition prematurely risks alienating professional contacts and triggering institutional defensiveness. Only consider raising it—preferably through HR or legal counsel—if the bank continues to stonewall, offers inconsistent justifications, or reveals clearly pretextual criteria, and you are prepared to pursue a formal dispute.
